verdict.rationale: Stable is a virtual mailbox, business address, and registered agent SaaS with a REST API and webhooks. It is not an AI agent or assistant that acts as an MCP client, so plugging external MCP servers into it is a category error for this product type. Its AI summaries and auto-routing do not make it a tool-calling agent, and nothing in the evidence shows it consuming MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
